data.title: W Residences Dubai - Downtown
data.about:
Welcome to W Residences Dubai – Downtown by Dar Al Arkan. 

Offering an eclectic collection of 1 – 3 BR apartments managed by W Hotels and serving an opulent lifestyle that is fit for the elite. Own a piece of this luxury and live minutes from Burj Khalifa, and wake up to fantastic views of the same. The amenities here are unheard of in an apartment residential destination. W Residences is the ideal place to find a home if you are looking for luxury lifestyle in the heart of Dubai.
